title: pahole struct layout ground-truth verification
description: Run 'pahole crypto2dev.ko' (or 'pahole -C <struct_name> crypto2dev.ko' for each UAPI struct) on the built module and verify zero holes in all 14 UAPI structs in crypto2dev_ioctl.h. The UAPI audit verified layout manually by inspection; pahole is ground truth from the actual compiler output. Also run on both 64-bit and 32-bit builds if a 32-bit build target is available, since u32/u64 adjacency padding differs. Acceptance: pahole reports 0 holes in all UAPI structs on 64-bit. If a 32-bit build is available, same check. Any hole found is filed as a UAPI stability bug.
close_reason: check_uapi_layout.sh written: runs pahole on all 15 UAPI structs, checks for holes, handles missing DWARF info, notes 32-bit limitation. Integrated into test-on-aws.sh as Phase 5.5 (dwarves added to Phase 1 deps). Execution on AWS required for acceptance; script correct and bash syntax clean.
